description: We are a team from Registan School. We want to spark an interest in celestial objects among students — and beyond.
summary:
Singularity’s is an interactive educational website that helps school-age students discover the stories and scientific achievements of six NASA spacecraft and instruments: Apollo 11’s lunar laser retroreflector, Voyager 1, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity and Perseverance. Our project explores what each object was designed to do, where it is now, whether it still works, and what scientists learned from it.

We developed a range of ways to make space science easier and more engaging: interactive 3D models, six mission-based games, short animated films, a timeline, a map showing the objects’ locations, photographs, quizzes, a glossary and a comparison tool. The website is available in English, Russian and Uzbek. It also links claims to NASA and JPL sources and distinguishes confirmed facts from interpretations and unanswered questions.

The challenge is that the history and technical details of space hardware can be difficult for young learners to understand. Singularity’s addresses this by turning reliable scientific information into visual, interactive experiences that students can explore at their own pace. By showing both successful discoveries and the limits of ageing equipment, our project encourages curiosity, critical thinking and a deeper appreciation of how space exploration expands human knowledge.
details:
Singularity’s is an interactive educational website that introduces students to six NASA missions: Apollo 11, Voyager 1, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity and Perseverance.

Our platform combines interactive 3D models, six mission-based games, animated films, a Solar System map, quizzes, a timeline and a scientific glossary. The Evidence Lab helps users distinguish confirmed facts from scientific interpretations and unanswered questions.

Our goal is to make complex space science accessible through interactive learning rather than traditional reading. Students can explore spacecraft, experience mission challenges and discover how these technologies contributed to scientific discoveries.

What makes our project unique is its combination of gamification, scientific storytelling and multilingual accessibility in English, Russian and Uzbek. We prioritized scientific accuracy, accessibility and educational value, using NASA and JPL resources to support our content.

Singularity’s aims to inspire the next generation of explorers, encourage critical thinking and make space science engaging for everyone.
